svg.title: 31 Instrumente im Orbit
svg.desc: A rotating 3D sphere with one point per instrument in the research data set, sized by how many 5-minute bars are stored and coloured by asset class: Majors: 5; Layer 1 / Layer 2: 12; DeFi & Oracles: 6; Payments & Forks: 5; Metaverse: 2; Index-Futures: 1.
svg.text: Jeder Punkt ist ein Instrument. Grösse = gespeicherte Bars.
TRX, ADA, ATOM, ALGO, DOT, AVAX, NEAR …
LINK, RUNE, UNI, FIL, AAVE, INJ
eine Umdrehung = 80 s · Binance 5 min + CME NQ · reine Datenabdeckung
